cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we sell this bottled cloud, measure from its third elbow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the new assistant. I can only find two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold the bottle. The third elbow appears when you call it 'Professor.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining inside the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Liquid elbow. Count the drops; I'll mark an inch for each one.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims measurement mastery, A3 helps the novice hold equipment while inventing title activation and A5 converts unexpected rain into the required third-elbow measurement.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 missing elbow causes A3 Professor rule; B4 rain causes A5 liquid elbow and drop-to-inch rule tied to the same task.

relationship.evidence: B2 states novice status and actual two-elbow observation; B4 tries title and reports rain.

heightening.evidence: A5 unexpected output becomes the missing measurement under another asserted rule, rather than an unrelated sleeve-size topic.

specificity.evidence: A1 cloud for sale and measuring elbow, B2 two found and B4 rain provide clear fantasy facts.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 two-word classification supports the count instruction and A recording work; it is useful to B rather than a reviewer gloss.
